is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the presence of L1014F kdr and CYP6P3P450 resistance mechanisms in the background (page 1) and cites previous studies for these, but does not report any new genotype data for these or any other markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted during August–October 2016 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a standard experimental hut trial of specific net products.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of DawaPlus 3.0 and 4.0 LLINs in experimental huts in Burkina Faso. While it discusses insecticide resistance mechanisms (kdr, P450s) in the background, it does not perform or report any new genotyping of resistance markers.
